title: Polytopes of Effective Boundary Expressions of Divisors on $\overline{M}_{0,n}$
summary: For a divisor on $\overline{M}_{0,n}$, we introduce the polytope of its effective boundary expressions. We establish structural properties of these polytopes under the forgetful maps of $\overline{M}_{0,n}$ forgetting marked points, and give equivalent graph-theoretic descriptions. We compute these polytopes for several families of divisors. For psi-classes and their pullbacks by forgetful maps, we show that the polytopes are unimodular simplices.
